figurative_meaning_en: almost destroyed, in a dilapidated or decaying state
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই পুরনো বাড়িটি হতপ্রায় হয়ে গেছে।
তার স্বাস্থ্য হতপ্রায় অবস্থায় পৌঁছে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: That old house is almost in ruins.
His health has reached a near-decayed state.
note: This idiom vividly captures the imagery of gradual deterioration, common in Bengali descriptive prose.
